# Flatout Motor Cars

> Flatout Motor Cars builds the Drakan: a 2,000-pound, street-legal Formula race car, hand-built one buyer at a time in Miami, Florida. It pairs Formula-style racing suspension and a tubular chromoly chassis with an LS3 6.2L V8, delivering a true race-car experience that stays legal and serviceable on public roads.

Flatout Motor Cars was founded by Albert Gocsman, a racing driver with decades of seat time. Every car is built to the owner's specification on a proven platform, from a turnkey car to a fully bespoke commission. The company designs and builds in Miami and sells directly to owners.

## The Drakan: key specifications

- Curb weight: approximately 2,000 lbs (wet)
- 0 to 60 mph: 2.8 seconds
- Top speed: 175 mph
- Engine: LS3 6.2L V8
- Transmission: Getrag 6-speed manual
- Pedal box: bespoke racecar pedal box
- Chassis: tubular chromoly steel with an integrated driver cage
- Suspension: Formula pushrod with bell-crank actuation; Formula One geometry engineered to be road-compliant
- Body: composite, with a carbon-fiber body available on higher tiers
- Legality: street legal and plate-ready; serviceable anywhere, with body panels that release with a single push and parts chosen to be sourceable anywhere

## Builds and pricing

- Tier I, Turnkey: from $200,000. The proven foundation car, ready to drive.
- Tier II, Carbon: from $225,000. Carbon-fiber body and an elevated build, with forced-induction paths available.
- Tier III, Bespoke: custom pricing. A fully custom order built to the owner's specification, including bespoke engine and drivetrain, materials, and interior.

Pricing is a starting point and is finalized with each build.
